mermaid:
flowchart LR
    P1["Provider announces the new version and the sunset date"] --> P2["Old and new versions run side by side"]
    P2 --> P3["Provider monitors who still calls the old version"]
    P3 --> P4["Sunset date passes and the old version is removed"]
    P1 -->|"notice reaches a role, not a person"| C1["Consumer records the date in the integration inventory"]
    C1 --> C2["Consumer tests against the new version in a sandbox"]
    C2 --> C3["Consumer switches the pinned version before sunset"]
    C3 --> P4

sequenceDiagram
    participant PL as the platform
    participant WH as Webhook receiver
    participant Q as Queue
    participant W as Worker
    participant OMS as the OMS
    PL->>WH: POST order created, signed, delivery id 8812
    WH->>WH: Verify signature and timestamp
    WH->>Q: Store the raw delivery with id 8812
    WH-->>PL: 200 OK well inside five seconds
    Q->>W: Hand over delivery 8812
    W->>W: Seen 8812 before? No
    W->>OMS: Create order 1072455, idempotency key is the order number
    PL->>WH: POST order created, delivery id 8812 again, a retry
    WH-->>PL: 200 OK
    Q->>W: Hand over 8812
    W->>W: Seen 8812 before? Yes, skip
    Note over W,OMS: Nightly sweep fetches orders updated since the last run
